newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NIMES SEE EUROPEAN DREAM SLIP AWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIMES SEE EUROPEAN DREAM SLIP AWAY.

text.p: French third division club Nimes' dreams of reaching the quarter-finals of the Cup Winners Cup look forlorn after they were beaten 3-1 by AIK Stockholm in a one-sided encounter on Thursday.
Nimes, playing before their home fans, were looking forward to another upset after knocking out Kispest Honved of Hungary in the first round.

But Stockholm scored twice in three minutes in the first-half as Pascal Simpson exploited a blunder from Nimes' Polish goalkeeper Stanislaw Karwat in the ninth minute and Cesar Pacha made it 2-0 with a close-range effort in the 12th.
Stockholm stayed on top of a naive Nimes side in the second half and scored a further goal through Mattias Johansson in the 70th minute.
Nimes finally managed to reduce the deficit in the last minute thanks to a superb shot from substitute Sebastien Fidani.
"It looks like it's all over," said Nimes trainer Pierre Mosca, whose team qualified for Europe by reaching the French Cup final.
"It's a bit sad. If we had played in the first half the way we did in the second, maybe we would have had a chance."
